checks.text: On first open the fields labelled "Principal", "Annual rate %" and "Years" hold 100000, 5 and 30, and the results show "Monthly payment" $536.82, "Total interest" $93,255.78 and "Total paid" $193,255.78.
Typing 15 in the field labelled "Years" shows "Monthly payment" $790.79 and "Total interest" $42,342.85.
Typing 50000 in "Principal", 0 in "Annual rate %" and 5 in "Years" shows "Monthly payment" $833.33 and "Total interest" $0.00.
Typing 25000 in "Principal", 7.5 in "Annual rate %" and 5 in "Years" shows "Monthly payment" $500.95 and "Total interest" $5,056.92.
With the first-open values, clicking "Show schedule" shows a table with 360 payment rows; the row for payment 1 shows payment $536.82, interest $416.67, principal $120.15 and balance $99,879.85.
With the first-open values, the row for payment 360 shows balance $0.00.

Typing -100 in the field labelled "Principal" shows the message "Principal must be between 1 and 100,000,000" and the results keep showing the last valid values; typing 80 in "Years" shows the message "Years must be between 1 and 50".
Clicking "Save loan" adds a row to the list labelled "Saved loans" that contains $536.82; before any loan is saved the list shows "No saved loans yet".

Reload keeps the work: after typing 25000 in "Principal", 7.5 in "Annual rate %" and 5 in "Years", clicking "Save loan" and reloading, the results show "Monthly payment" $500.95 and the saved loans list contains $500.95.
